The Residency-Octree Update method was introduced in the context of scalable web-based volume rendering of large biomedicine datasets.
It was designed to efficiently manage the residency of volume bricks in a GPU cache while maintaining a hierarchical octree structure for culling.
Dynamic Octree Generation was introduced in the context of Mega-NeRF for scalable construction of large-scale NeRFs.
